title: Resource Monitor
description: Settings for the resource monitor status bar items and kernel usage panel.

showMemory.title: Show memory
showMemory.description: Show the memory usage item in the status bar.

showCpu.title: Show CPU
showCpu.description: Show the CPU usage item in the status bar.

showMemoryPercent.title: Show memory percentage
showMemoryPercent.description: Show the used-of-limit percentage in the memory item.

cpuMode.title: CPU display mode
cpuMode.description: How the CPU reading is shown. 'normalised' is the share of all cores together (0-100%); 'aggregate' sums each core's own 100%, as top reports it; 'bar' shows a filled bar instead of a number, full when every core is saturated.

showKernelUsage.title: Show kernel usage panel
showKernelUsage.description: Show the sidebar panel with usage for the current notebook's kernel. The kernel is measured only while the panel is open.
